name: zsnd_sample_play_direct_sound
description: zSndSample::PlayDirectSound gates streaming/group samples, applies marker start/stop metadata when the requested variant is in range, multiplies sample/gain/global volume, and dispatches through PlayOnActiveBackend.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zSound playback/source cluster because this wrapper shares backend dispatch shape with PlayA3D and PlayOnActiveBackend.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49fd50 validates the createGuard early return, in-range markerTimes/markerAux handling, markerBaseTime update, g_zSndLastVoiceStopMarkerIndex store, backend argument selection from markerAux[variantIndex * 2], global volume pointer handling, gain multiplication, and dispatch to zSndSample::PlayOnActiveBackend with null world position and velocity.

The native DirectSound smoke verifies ordinary playback dispatch, marker-index playback dispatch with markerBaseTime/stop-marker/backend-position side effects, global gain calculation, and createGuard rejection.
